A '''drag course''' used for [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] existed on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] spice-mining [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Mon Gazza/Legends|Mon Gazza]]. The [[Bardottan/Legends|Phuii]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Mars Guo/Legends|Mars Guo]] favored this course, and would challenge opponents on it.<ref name="E1R" />

==Behind the scenes==
The course first appeared, unnamed, in the [[1999]] [[Wikipedia:Nintendo Game Boy|Gameboy Color]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|Star Wars Episode I: Racer]]''.
